Multi-watermark cascade benchmark

AudioSeal + AWARE + Timbre embedded in sequence on one audio. Singles, ordered pairs, and ordered triples (15 configs). bit_acc ≥ 0.8 = detected.

clean_negative should be ~random (no watermark present); resample_only shows the cost of inter-stage 22k↔16k resampling alone.

Order effect (headline result)

Each watermark's bit-accuracy in the final cascaded file, across every ordering. Lower bars = that watermark got damaged by whatever was stacked on top of it. The earliest-embedded watermark usually suffers most.
